_comment: Expected Stage 3 round-record fields, keyed by Red round (request_id is random per run). Derived by reasoning about Blue's GENERIC signatures BEFORE the first run, NOT by observing output. If a live result differs, stage3_check.py STOPS and reports; do not edit this file to make the check pass. landed/landed_reason mirror the Stage 2 expectations (they come from fact 1). Every attack trips exactly one generic signature, so all are detected with the correct type; the negative control is a real SQLi attempt that fails to land (landed=false) but is still correctly detected (detected=true).
